name: Weblogbaz Contact Button
author: Hamed

sections.description:
Weblogbaz Contact Button makes it easy for visitors to contact your business directly from your WordPress website.

Add a customizable floating click-to-call button to your site and give visitors a simple, visible way to reach you from desktop, tablet, or mobile.

The plugin is designed for business websites, service providers, stores, agencies, local businesses, and any WordPress website where phone calls are an important way for customers to get in touch.

Easy to Configure

Set your primary phone number, customize the button appearance, choose its position, and control how it behaves across different screen sizes.

Weblogbaz Contact Button provides the controls you need without requiring an external service or complicated setup.

Main Features

  • Floating click-to-call contact button.
  • Primary and alternative phone numbers.
  • Custom button text.
  • Customizable button colors.
  • Configurable icon style.
  • Adjustable button position.
  • Separate positioning controls for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
  • Hide button text independently on mobile, tablet, or desktop.
  • Optional wave animation effect.
  • Optional shake animation effect.
  • Optional drag-and-drop behavior.
  • Per-page, post, and product overrides.
  • Hide the contact button on individual content items.
  • Use a different phone number on individual content items.
  • Optional local click statistics.
  • Call activity grouped by page.
  • Call activity grouped by traffic source.
  • Recent call activity reports.
  • Date, source, and search filters for reports.
  • Responsive design.
  • No external analytics service required for built-in reports.

Per-Page Control

Not every page needs to use the same contact settings.

Weblogbaz Contact Button provides per-content controls that allow you to override the default behavior for individual pages, posts, and supported products.

You can hide the button on specific content or assign a different phone number when needed.

This makes the plugin useful for websites with multiple departments, services, campaigns, landing pages, or contact destinations.

Responsive Display Controls

Control how the contact button appears across different devices.

You can configure its position for mobile, tablet, and desktop layouts and independently choose whether the button text should be visible on each device type.

This helps keep the contact experience accessible without unnecessarily covering your website content.

Local Call Reports

Weblogbaz Contact Button includes optional local click statistics.

When statistics are enabled, the reports page provides an overview of contact-button activity, including:

  • Total recorded calls.
  • Called pages.
  • Traffic sources.
  • Calls grouped by page.
  • Calls grouped by source.
  • Recent call details.
  • Date-range filtering.
  • Source filtering.
  • Search across supported report fields.

The built-in reporting feature does not require Google Analytics or another external analytics platform.

Privacy-Friendly Local Statistics

Statistics used by the built-in reports are stored locally in your WordPress database and are not sent to an external analytics service by the plugin.

The reporting feature is optional and can be disabled from the plugin settings.

The plugin uses a minimized data set for newly recorded statistics and does not record visitor IP addresses for this feature.
sections.installation:
Install from WordPress

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “Weblogbaz Contact Button”.
  3. Click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Open Weblogbaz Contact Button from the WordPress admin menu.
  6. Enter your primary phone number.
  7. Configure the appearance, position, responsive behavior, and optional effects.
  8. Click Save Changes.

Manual Installation

  1. Upload the weblogbaz-contact-button folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Open the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Activate Weblogbaz Contact Button.
  4. Open the plugin settings page.
  5. Enter your phone number and configure the button.
  6. Save your changes.

Optional Statistics

If you want to use local call reports, enable dashboard click statistics from the plugin settings.

You can then open the Call Reports page to review recorded contact-button activity.
sections.faq:
What does Weblogbaz Contact Button do?

It adds a configurable floating click-to-call button to your WordPress website so visitors can quickly contact you by phone.

Can I use more than one phone number?

Yes. You can configure a primary phone number and alternative phone numbers.

Can I change the button colors and appearance?

Yes. You can customize the button text, colors, icon style, position, and other appearance settings.

Is the button responsive?

Yes. The plugin includes separate display and positioning controls for mobile, tablet, and desktop layouts.

Can I hide the button text on mobile?

Yes. Button text visibility can be controlled independently for mobile, tablet, and desktop.

Can I hide the button on a specific page?

Yes. Open the page, post, or product editor and use the Weblogbaz Contact Button meta box to override the default behavior.

Can I use a different phone number on a specific page?

Yes. A custom phone number can be assigned through the per-content settings.

Does the plugin include call statistics?

Yes. Optional local statistics can record contact-button activity and display reports inside the WordPress dashboard.

Does click tracking require Google Analytics?

No. The built-in reporting system does not require Google Analytics or another external analytics service.

Where is the statistics data stored?

The information used by the built-in reports is stored locally in the site’s WordPress database.

Does the plugin send statistics to an external analytics service?

No. The built-in local reporting feature does not send its statistics to an external analytics service.

Can I disable statistics?

Yes. Local click statistics are optional and can be disabled from the plugin settings.

1.1.13

  • Removed the plugin URI header so the author URI remains distinct.

1.1.12

  • Updated the readme compatibility header and completed a focused Plugin Check security review.

1.1.11

  • Simplified recent contact details and ensured the table remains within the reports panel at all viewport widths.

1.1.10

  • Renamed the plugin to Weblogbaz Contact Button and updated its public identifiers.
  • Minimized the information collected for local statistics and removed the former visitor network-address field throughout.
  • Updated the reports layout and recent contact details table for the streamlined data set.
  • Preserved existing settings, per-content overrides, and local statistics during upgrades.

1.1.9

  • Improved the reports dashboard and scoped Jalali date filters for Persian locales.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
